lines.zh: 石足踏过古界砖，一寸不偏。
lines.en: Stone feet cross the ancient bricks, never off by an inch.

lines.zh: 我沿封印的边线走，走了千年。
lines.en: I walk the seal's border line, and have for a thousand years.

lines.zh: 每一步都量过，正好压住裂缝。
lines.en: Every step is measured and pressed exactly on the cracks.

lines.zh: 传送门的光在廊尽头，我绕它走。
lines.en: The portal glows at the corridor's end; I circle it.

lines.zh: 机体重了，落脚处砖面发响。
lines.en: My frame is heavy; the bricks groan where I land.

lines.zh: 无名者没有影子，只有脚步。
lines.en: The Nameless has no shadow, only footsteps.

lines.zh: 巡逻路线刻在骨头里，不用想。
lines.en: The patrol route is carved in my bones, no thinking needed.

lines.zh: 这条路我闭着眼也走得完。
lines.en: I could finish this road with my eyes shut.

lines.zh: 关节里的旧齿轮，一步一咬。
lines.en: Old gears in my joints bite once per step.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，灰尘都不敢落。
lines.en: Dust dares not settle where I have walked.

lines.zh: 封印还在响，我就还得站着。
lines.en: The seal still hums, so I still stand.

lines.zh: 重铸那日，铁律烙进我的壳。
lines.en: The day I was reforged, the iron law burned into my shell.

lines.zh: 远古史蒂夫封了不朽者，我封了门。
lines.en: Ancient Steve sealed the Undying; I sealed the door.

lines.zh: 我没有名字，守卫就是名字。
lines.en: I have no name; guardian is the name.

lines.zh: 站久了，砖缝里长出我的形状。
lines.en: Standing so long, my shape grows into the brick seams.

lines.zh: 戍卫核心在胸口，慢慢发烫。
lines.en: The warden core in my chest warms slowly.

lines.zh: 风从门缝漏出来，带着旧年的味道。
lines.en: Wind leaks through the door seam, smelling of old years.

lines.zh: 我记得封印前的最后一句话。
lines.en: I remember the last sentence spoken before the sealing.

lines.zh: 这身甲不是穿的，是长出来的。
lines.en: This armor was not worn; it grew on me.

lines.zh: 我把铁律念一遍，头脑就清了。
lines.en: I recite the iron law once, and my mind clears.

lines.zh: 睡着是奢侈，守卫不配。
lines.en: Sleep is a luxury a guardian cannot afford.

lines.zh: 廊柱的影子移了半圈，我还在这。
lines.en: The pillar's shadow moved half a circle; I am still here.

lines.zh: 有人来过又走了，砖上留着鞋印。
lines.en: Someone came and left; a boot print stays on the brick.

lines.zh: 门后很安静，安静得像在等。
lines.en: Behind the door it is quiet, quiet as waiting.

lines.zh: 我抬手摸了摸胸口的戍卫核心。
lines.en: I raise a hand to the core in my chest.

lines.zh: 门缝里有风，我数它吹了几次。
lines.en: Wind leaks through the door; I count its gusts.

lines.zh: 你站在门槛外，我数到第三声。
lines.en: You stand outside the threshold; I count to three.

lines.zh: 抬头，让我看清你的来路。
lines.en: Look up and let me see where you came from.

lines.zh: 你的手在抖，我看得见。
lines.en: Your hands are shaking; I can see that.

lines.zh: 这双眼里没有怜悯，只有距离。
lines.en: These eyes hold no pity, only distance.

lines.zh: 你离传送门还有七块砖。
lines.en: You are still seven bricks from the portal.

lines.zh: 我记住你的步幅，别想绕。
lines.en: I have your stride length; do not try to circle.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾着别处的草屑。
lines.en: Your boots carry grass bits from elsewhere.

lines.zh: 抬头说话，我从不低头看人。
lines.en: Speak with your head up; I never look down at people.

lines.zh: 你笑了，上一个笑的人成了砖。
lines.en: You smile; the last one who smiled became brick.

lines.zh: 我不问姓名，名字留着也没用。
lines.en: I do not ask names; names are of no use here.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到线上了，退半步。
lines.en: Your shadow crosses the line; step back half a pace.

lines.zh: 眼睛对眼睛，你输了。
lines.en: Eye to eye, and you have already lost.

lines.zh: 这处凹陷，我留作记号。
lines.en: I keep this dent as a marker.

lines.zh: 壳上有印，我不擦。
lines.en: There is a mark on my shell; I will not wipe it.

lines.zh: 痒，仅此而已。
lines.en: It tickles, nothing more.

lines.zh: 你打中了一条旧焊缝。
lines.en: You hit an old weld seam.

lines.zh: 力道不错，方向太差。
lines.en: Decent force, poor angle.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是为了看你的刀。
lines.en: I step back half a pace to study your blade.

lines.zh: 甲碎了会换，铁律不会。
lines.en: Broken armor gets replaced; the law does not.

lines.zh: 这就是你的全部本事？
lines.en: Is that all the skill you have?

lines.zh: 我又不疼，你反倒累了。
lines.en: I feel no pain, yet you are the tired one.

lines.zh: 修我的人还没出生。
lines.en: Whoever can repair me is not born yet.

lines.zh: 食物？我的肚子是空的铁盒。
lines.en: Food? My belly is an empty iron box.

lines.zh: 你把面包举高，我只看你的手。
lines.en: You raise the bread; I only watch your hand.

lines.zh: 献祭摆了一地，我一块没动。
lines.en: Offerings cover the floor; I have touched none.

lines.zh: 我不饿，我只是很久没动了。
lines.en: I am not hungry; I have simply not moved in ages.

lines.zh: 想用吃的换门？你算错了。
lines.en: Trade food for the door? You have miscalculated.

lines.zh: 那袋谷物放下，人可以走了。
lines.en: Leave the sack of grain; the person may go.

lines.zh: 我的燃料是铁律，不是面包。
lines.en: My fuel is the iron law, not bread.

lines.zh: 你晃着手里的东西，像逗狗。
lines.en: You wave that thing as if teasing a dog.

lines.zh: 香味飘过来，我不为所动。
lines.en: The smell drifts over; I do not stir.

lines.zh: 供养能留，心不能留。
lines.en: Offerings may stay; your intent may not.

lines.zh: 撞上我的甲，你退了三步。
lines.en: You hit my armor and fall back three steps.

lines.zh: 我不用让路，路会让开我。
lines.en: I do not yield the path; the path yields to me.

lines.zh: 砖面上有你滑出去的痕迹。
lines.en: There is a smear where you slid off the brick.

lines.zh: 肩膀是铸的，撞它没好处。
lines.en: My shoulder is cast metal; hitting it gains nothing.

lines.zh: 你贴得太近了，退到线外。
lines.en: You are too close; get back beyond the line.

lines.zh: 我站着不动，你自己弹开了。
lines.en: I stand still, and you bounce off by yourself.

lines.zh: 这一下不算攻击，只是提示。
lines.en: That was not an attack, only a reminder.

lines.zh: 硬碰硬，你的骨头先响。
lines.en: Hard against hard, and your bones creak first.

lines.zh: 门前的空地窄，两个人太挤。
lines.en: The ground before the door is narrow, too cramped for two.

lines.zh: 下次绕开我，能省一副护甲。
lines.en: Walk around me next time and save your armor.

lines.zh: 守卫没有同族，只有同一条命令。
lines.en: Guardians have no kin, only one shared command.

lines.zh: 铸我的炉子早冷了，没有第二个我。
lines.en: The forge that made me is cold; there is no second me.

lines.zh: 若有两个我，也只会互相看守。
lines.en: If there were two of me, we would only watch each other.

lines.zh: 我的伴侣是这道封印。
lines.en: My companion is this seal.

lines.zh: 机兵不谈血脉，只谈编号。
lines.en: Constructs speak not of bloodline, only of serial numbers.

lines.zh: 想给我配对？先把铁律改了。
lines.en: Pair me off? First rewrite the iron law.

lines.zh: 并肩站过千年，也没生出什么。
lines.en: Standing shoulder to shoulder a thousand years bred nothing.

lines.zh: 我不留后代，只留岗位。
lines.en: I leave no offspring, only a post.

lines.zh: 另一个守卫在更深的廊里，我们不见面。
lines.en: Another guardian waits deeper in the corridor; we never meet.

lines.zh: 要延续，得先有第二个铁砧。
lines.en: To continue the line, you would need a second anvil.

lines.zh: 这块古界砖，放回原来的缺口。
lines.en: This ancient brick goes back into its gap.

lines.zh: 地上有枚水晶，我捡起来收好。
lines.en: A crystal lies on the ground; I pick it up.

lines.zh: 不属于这里的物件，我一律收走。
lines.en: Anything not of this place, I take away.

lines.zh: 你的剑掉了，我先替你看着。
lines.en: You dropped your sword; I will watch it for now.

lines.zh: 我把碎屑扫进甲缝，别脏了砖。
lines.en: I sweep the crumbs into my seams so the brick stays clean.

lines.zh: 这枚扣子，是谁留下的？
lines.en: This button, who left it behind?

lines.zh: 拾起来，登记，再放回原处。
lines.en: Pick it up, log it, put it back.

lines.zh: 手不空着，眼也不空着。
lines.en: My hands are never empty, nor are my eyes.

lines.zh: 掉在地上的东西，都算证物。
lines.en: Whatever falls to the floor counts as evidence.

lines.zh: 我只捡不藏，柜子在廊尽头。
lines.en: I only collect, never hide; the shelf is at the corridor's end.

lines.zh: 目标锁定：越线者，一名。
lines.en: Target locked: one line-crosser.

lines.zh: 你踏过了第三块砖，够了。
lines.en: You set foot on the third brick; that is enough.

lines.zh: 铁律第一句：凡接近传送门者。
lines.en: First line of the law: whoever nears the portal.

lines.zh: 数据够了，判决下来了。
lines.en: The data is sufficient; the verdict is in.

lines.zh: 我的心口亮了一下，那是许可。
lines.en: My chest lights once; that is permission.

lines.zh: 你转身跑，正好省得我追。
lines.en: You turn and run, saving me the pursuit.

lines.zh: 视线锁住，你就没法消失。
lines.en: Sightline locked; you cannot slip away now.

lines.zh: 门口的守卫只有一个职责。
lines.en: The guardian at the door has one duty only.

lines.zh: 你带来的一切，都写在判决里。
lines.en: Everything you brought is written in the verdict.

lines.zh: 我不愤怒，我只是开始执行。
lines.en: I am not angry; I have merely begun enforcing.

lines.zh: 从这刻起，你的路只剩退路。
lines.en: From this moment your only road is backward.

lines.zh: 廊里的灯灭了，是为了方便我。
lines.en: The corridor lamps went dark, which suits me.

lines.zh: 你的心跳快了两拍，我听见了。
lines.en: Your heartbeat doubled; I heard it.

lines.zh: 别怪铁律，怪你自己走近。
lines.en: Blame the iron law less than your own approach.

lines.zh: 传送门的蓝光晃了一下，有人。
lines.en: The portal's blue light wavers: someone.

lines.zh: 砖面传来震动，不止一个脚步。
lines.en: The bricks tremble with more than one step.

lines.zh: 我把头转向东廊，那里有呼吸。
lines.en: I turn to the east hall; breathing there.

lines.zh: 判决只有一条，我不用多想。
lines.en: There is only one verdict; no need to think.

lines.zh: 一步，两步，你的距离在缩。
lines.en: One step, two, your distance shrinks.

lines.zh: 你躲到柱后，柱挡不住影子。
lines.en: You hide behind a pillar; it hides no shadow.

lines.zh: 我在算你下一步落在哪块砖。
lines.en: I am calculating which brick you step on next.

lines.zh: 跑吧，这条廊子是直的。
lines.en: Run then; this corridor is straight.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，那是倒计时。
lines.en: My joints creak; that is the countdown.

lines.zh: 你喘得比刚才重了。
lines.en: Your breathing is heavier than it was before.

lines.zh: 你歇脚的工夫，我缩短三格。
lines.en: While you catch your breath, I close three blocks.

lines.zh: 你身后的门是锁着的，我知道。
lines.en: The door behind you is locked; I know.

lines.zh: 追你不费力，你的鞋底太软。
lines.en: Chasing you is easy; your soles are too soft.

lines.zh: 我只看一次机会，你已经用完。
lines.en: I grant one chance; you have spent it.

lines.zh: 你向左，我的影子也向左。
lines.en: You go left, and my shadow goes left.

lines.zh: 这身机体的耐心比走廊长。
lines.en: This frame's patience is longer than the corridor.

lines.zh: 地面在传你的脚步，很清楚。
lines.en: The floor carries your footsteps, quite clearly.

lines.zh: 再退，会撞上封印的门框。
lines.en: Back up more and you will hit the seal's frame.

lines.zh: 我把通道封成一条直线。
lines.en: I close the corridor into one straight line.

lines.zh: 你往左，左墙会替我拦你。
lines.en: Go left; the left wall stops you for me.

lines.zh: 我每走一步，砖就碎一格。
lines.en: Each step I take breaks a tile.

lines.zh: 你的火把照不到我的关节。
lines.en: Your torch does not reach my joints.

lines.zh: 我已算好你退到门口的时间。
lines.en: I have timed your retreat to the door.

lines.zh: 你换手拿盾时，我近了半步。
lines.en: When you switch the shield, I gain half a step.

lines.zh: 这一拳，替你校准站姿。
lines.en: This fist will correct your stance.

lines.zh: 甲背砸下去，砖都陷了。
lines.en: The armor back comes down and the brick sinks.

lines.zh: 我的拳没有花招，只有重量。
lines.en: My fist has no tricks, only weight.

lines.zh: 戍卫核心推到峰值，出手。
lines.en: The warden core peaks, and I strike.

lines.zh: 你挡了，护甲凹成了碗。
lines.en: You blocked; your plate dented into a bowl.

lines.zh: 别贴在柱边，我会连柱一起砸。
lines.en: Do not hug the pillar; I will smash through it.

lines.zh: 击中。记录。继续巡守。
lines.en: Hit. Logged. Continue with the patrol.

lines.zh: 铁律不许我停手。
lines.en: The iron law does not permit me to stop.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖先软了，身体还没倒。
lines.en: Your knees buckle before your body falls.

lines.zh: 我打的是位置，不是人。
lines.en: I strike a position, not a person.

lines.zh: 半空中的你，落地会偏。
lines.en: Midair as you are, you will land crooked.

lines.zh: 这一下留了力，门还要人守。
lines.en: I held back; the door still needs a keeper.

lines.zh: 关节转过半圈，你退了两丈。
lines.en: My joint turned half a circle and you flew two yards.

lines.zh: 疼痛是提示，让你记住线在哪。
lines.en: Pain is a hint, so you remember where the line is.

lines.zh: 炉火重燃，我睁开眼。
lines.en: The forge fire relights, and I open my eyes.

lines.zh: 古界砖一块块归位，我在其中醒来。
lines.en: Ancient bricks slide back into place, and I wake among them.

lines.zh: 铁律先醒，机体后醒。
lines.en: The iron law wakes first; the frame follows.

lines.zh: 封印叫我起来，我就起来。
lines.en: The seal calls me up, and I rise.

lines.zh: 这具身体是新的，记忆是旧的。
lines.en: This body is new; the memory is old.

lines.zh: 名号没有，职位有一个。
lines.en: No title, but one post.

lines.zh: 我踩过的第一块砖，有了裂纹。
lines.en: The first brick I stand on takes a crack.

lines.zh: 门还在，锁还在，我就得在这。
lines.en: The door stands, the lock holds, so here I stay.

lines.zh: 有人动了封印的钉子。
lines.en: Someone has disturbed the seal's nails.

lines.zh: 我从砖堆里把自己拔出来。
lines.en: I pull myself out of the brick pile.

lines.zh: 再次重铸，再次看守。
lines.en: Reforged again, watching again.

lines.zh: 眼睛亮起时，走廊已经安静了。
lines.en: When my eyes light, the corridor is already quiet.

lines.zh: 谁唤醒我，谁就得解释。
lines.en: Whoever wakes me must explain why.

lines.zh: 我回来的第一件事，是数砖。
lines.en: The first thing I do on return is count the bricks.

lines.zh: 锻造模板归位，炉火照我起身。
lines.en: The template settles; the forge light raises me.

lines.zh: 我从古界砖的缝里被拼回来。
lines.en: I am pieced back from the old realm bricks.

lines.zh: 封印松了一指宽，我立刻醒。
lines.en: The seal loosens a finger's width; I wake.

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步，砖灰落满肩。
lines.en: First step out, brick dust on my shoulders.

lines.zh: 这具新机体还没上油，先站着。
lines.en: This new frame is unoiled; I stand first.

lines.zh: 我睁眼先看门，门还锁着。
lines.en: I open my eyes to the door; still locked.

lines.zh: 炉子早熄了，这点火不够热。
lines.en: My forge went cold long ago; this fire is lukewarm.

lines.zh: 落地时砖碎了，我没事。
lines.en: The brick shattered on landing; I am fine.

lines.zh: 水漫到胸口，核心开始发闷。
lines.en: Water rises to my chest, and the core grows dull.

lines.zh: 炸开一层甲，里面还有两层。
lines.en: It blasted off one layer; two remain underneath.

lines.zh: 箭钉在肩缝里，取出来就行。
lines.en: The arrow sticks in my shoulder seam; I will pull it out.

lines.zh: 这股法力想改写我，写不动。
lines.en: That magic tries to rewrite me and cannot.

lines.zh: 不进食也能站，只是慢一些。
lines.en: I stand without eating, only slower.

lines.zh: 雷劈在避雷的旧钉上，浪费。
lines.en: Lightning hit an old rod nail; a waste.

lines.zh: 我在虚空中下坠，铁律还在。
lines.en: I fall through the void, and the law remains.
